top_signals.title: Anthropic sets price range of $70 to $78 in upcoming IPO as AI lab marches towards Nasdaq
top_signals.summary: Anthropic's IPO is expected to come roughly five months after Elon Musk took SpaceX public in a record offering.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Angola’s Bonds Lead Retreat Among Emerging-Market Oil Producers
top_signals.summary: Angola’s eurobonds led the retreat among frontier and emerging market oil-producers after Brent crude tumbled below $90 a barrel for the first time since August.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
